challengeTypes: identify: Which tool copies formatting from one place and applies it to another? (Format Painter vs Spell Check vs WordArt vs Page Setup)

sort: Drag each formatting feature to its correct description (Format Painter = copies formatting from one text to another | Superscript = raises text above the line (x2) | Subscript = lowers text below the line (H2O) | Shadow = adds a shadow behind text | Bold = makes text thicker | Italic = slants text)
identify: Where does a HEADER appear in a document? (At the top of every page vs At the bottom of every page | Only on the first page | Only in the middle)

sort: Drag each page setup option to its correct description (Margins = space between text and page edge | Orientation = portrait (tall) or landscape (wide) | Page size = A4, Letter, Legal | Page break = starts a new page | Header = top area of every page | Footer = bottom area of every page)
identify: What does WordArt do? (Creates decorative text with special effects vs Checks spelling | Counts words | Inserts a table)

sort: Drag each Word feature to its correct description (WordArt = decorative stylized text | Shapes = rectangles, circles, arrows | Pictures = images inserted from file | Watermark = faint text or image behind content | Page border = decorative border around page | Cover page = designed first page of document)
identify: Which page orientation is WIDER than it is tall? (Landscape vs Portrait vs A4 vs Letter)

sort: Drag each document element to where it belongs (Header = page number at top | Footer = page number at bottom | Cover page = title and author on first page | Watermark = DRAFT or CONFIDENTIAL behind text | Page border = decorative frame around page | Page break = forces new page)
extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Advanced formatting — Format Painter: copies formatting (font, size, color, style) from one text and applies it to another. Superscript: raises text above the baseline, smaller (x2, m2). Subscript: lowers text below the baseline, smaller (H2O, CO2). Shadow: adds a shadow effect behind text for emphasis. (2) Headers, footers, page setup — Header: text at the top of every page (document title, chapter name). Footer: text at the bottom of every page (page number, date). Page setup: Margins (space between text and page edge — normal, narrow, wide). Orientation: Portrait (tall, vertical) or Landscape (wide, horizontal). Page size: A4, Letter, Legal. Page break: forces content to start on a new page. (3) Shapes, WordArt, pictures, watermark, borders, cover page — WordArt: decorative text with colors, shadows, outlines, and 3D effects. Shapes: rectangles, circles, arrows, callouts that can be drawn on the document. Pictures: images inserted from files or online. Watermark: faint text or image behind the document content (DRAFT, CONFIDENTIAL, URGENT). Page border: decorative border around the edge of the page. Cover page: a designed first page with title, subtitle, author, and date. Misconceptions: 'format painter and copy-paste are the same' (WRONG — copy-paste copies text content; format painter copies only the FORMATTING, not the text), 'superscript and subscript are the same' (WRONG — superscript raises text above the line; subscript lowers text below the line), 'header and footer are the same' (WRONG — header is at the TOP of every page; footer is at the BOTTOM of every page), 'portrait orientation is wider than landscape' (WRONG — portrait is tall and narrow; landscape is wide and horizontal), 'watermark is the same as a page border' (WRONG — watermark is a faint image or text BEHIND the content; page border is a decorative frame AROUND the edge of the page).
